Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Accellion FTA secure file-transfer service
Data theft via unauthorized access to files transferred using the service
Ransom demands threatening public release of stolen data
Impacted Systems: Companies using Accellion FTA service including Kroger, Singtel, QIMR Berghofer Medical Research Institute, Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC), Office of the Washington State Auditor (SAO)
Attack Vector: Zero-day vulnerability exploitation in Accellion FTA software
Indicators of Compromise: Data breach advisories from affected companies
Ransom notes demanding payment to prevent data release
